page.description: FreeDOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source, MS-DOS-compatible operating system for PCs, still released and still able to run DOS programs and games on real hardware or in a virtual machine.
pros: Runs DOS programs and games on period hardware and in virtual machines.
Free, open source and actively maintained, with monthly test builds.
Media for CD, USB, floppy and virtual machines.
A 20 MB disk is enough for a plain installation.
cons: Needs BIOS or UEFI in Legacy mode: no native UEFI and no Secure Boot.
The media ship as ZIP archives: unzip before writing the contained image.
The kernel is still the 1.3 one; a new kernel is only in test builds.
Single-tasking DOS: no memory protection and no modern drivers.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for FreeDOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: The project publishes its media as ZIP archives containing the bootable images. Unzip a package, then write the contained image to a USB stick or burn it to a CD. Writing an image erases the target device.

editions.name: LiveCD
editions.description: Complete user-based DOS system with standard programs, applications, drivers and games.
editions.usbNote: 294 MB ZIP holding the LiveCD image. Unzip it, then write the image or burn a CD.

editions.name: LegacyCD
editions.description: The same FreeDOS 1.4 installation with the older boot method, for machines that cannot boot the LiveCD.
editions.usbNote: 274 MB ZIP holding the LegacyCD image. Unzip it, then write the image or burn a CD.

editions.name: FullUSB
editions.description: Complete installation packaged as a bootable USB image.
editions.usbNote: 669 MB ZIP holding the full USB image. Unzip it, then write the image to a stick.

editions.name: LiteUSB
editions.description: Minimal bootable USB image without the larger application and game sets.
editions.usbNote: 18 MB ZIP holding the lite USB image. Unzip it, then write the image to a stick.

editions.name: BonusCD
editions.description: Development tools, editors, boot tools, OpenGEM and extra utilities on a separate CD image.
editions.usbNote: 402 MB ZIP holding the BonusCD image. Unzip it, then burn a CD or write the image.

editions.name: Floppy edition
editions.description: Floppy-only edition for original IBM PC, XT and AT machines, in 720 kB, 1.2 MB and 1.44 MB versions.
editions.usbNote: 24 MB ZIP holding the floppy images. Unzip it and write the images to floppy disks.
